t: Replacement filters for both the Force 10 full face mask and Force 8 half mask (both available separately). Suitable for organic vapours and gases with class 1, low efficiency and dust particles with class 2, medium efficiency. For dusts such as fibreglass, plaster and MDF as well as nuisance odours and mists.
